name: Armand Manufacturing
old_description: Armand Manufacturing is your source for Vinyl and Poly Packaging, Specialty Products, and Static Control Products.
about:
Armand Manufacturing, Inc. has operated from Henderson, Nevada since its founding in 1948. The company occupies a 42,000-square-foot facility and has spent more than six decades producing plastic bags, covers and specialty items. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available materials.

The product line spans vinyl envelopes, holders and covers; polyethylene bags and cushion bags; static-control packaging such as shielded bags, shop travelers and badge holders; and fabric covers made from nylon cloth or static-safe nylon cloth. All items are offered with custom sizing, closures and features to match customer specifications. The facility supports this range of sewing, welding and converting operations under one roof.

While the company does not list target industries explicitly, its static-control and cleanroom-oriented products point to electronics assembly, semiconductor handling and related high-tech manufacturing. The vinyl and poly packaging lines also serve general industrial packaging, material handling and storage needs. Custom work is highlighted as a core offering for any application requiring tailored protective covers or bags.

Armand emphasizes that its products are custom designed to meet specific requirements, a capability built on decades of experience in the static-control packaging market dating back to the early recognition of electrostatic discharge risks. The company positions itself as a single source for vinyl, poly, fabric and static-control solutions.
